name: 01 · Parent onboarding
path: Register / sign in → create or join household → Today get-started card → first chore or event

Happy: Household ready
Create or join the canonical household; invite and first-action prompts live on Today.
Continue to Today; do one useful action.
Empty: Start your household
Explain create vs join before requesting a household name or invitation code.
Create household or enter a code.
Error: Keep the form
Show the real failure in words; retain safe typed fields. Do not show household creation as complete.
Correct the field or retry the failed step.
Offline: Connection needed
Sign-in, membership and household creation are not queued offline.
Keep safe draft text and try again online.
Permission: Use your own account
A paired device cannot become a personal session through this flow.
Set up on a parent’s phone; pair separately.
Loading: Creating the household
Keep safe draft fields and show the operation as pending; prevent a second submit.
Wait for confirmation or a visible error.

name: 02 · Pair a shared tablet
path: Phone Settings → Devices → create 10-minute code → tablet enters code → parent confirms four digits → device Today

Happy: Confirm this tablet
Check the four digits on the intended tablet before issuing the device session.
Confirm on the phone; tablet opens Today.
Empty: Pair this tablet
No household data is shown before pairing. Parent creates a code in personal Settings.
Enter the 8-character code on the tablet.
Error: Code did not work
Expired, cancelled, mismatched or device-limit states keep the tablet unpaired.
Ask for a new code; retry the enter step.
Offline: Waiting for confirmation
A network error does not confirm pairing; polling waits only until code expiry.
Reconnect before expiry, or use a new code.
Permission: Disconnected / unavailable
Revocation or a disabled device feature wipes device state and hides all household data.
A parent pairs again, or uses a personal phone.
Loading: Checking the pairing
Disable duplicate claim or confirmation while pending. No device session exists until the server confirms.
Keep waiting within the code expiry window.

name: 03 · Morning glance
path: Wake or tap → Today or kid home → schedule, chores, groceries and tonight summary → allowed tile action

Happy: What happens today?
The shared board shows schedule, tasks, dinner and groceries; kid home starts with own missions.
Read first; tap one allowed tile or task.
Empty: Nothing here yet
Each empty tile names what is missing. No sample household events appear in production.
Use a permitted personal add flow.
Error: Can’t reach the board
Use an explicit retry message. Failed reads do not imply the household has no events.
Retry; show update age if a board is retained.
Offline: Updates paused
A current in-memory board may be retained with an offline label; no persisted cold-launch snapshot is implemented.
Reconnect. Never present retained data as fresh.
Permission: Shared means shared
No finances, private messages, addresses, medical details or account controls on device Today.
Use your personal phone for private data.
Loading: Loading today
Use an explicit loading state; an initial fetch is not an empty household. Cold launch has no persisted snapshot.
Show the board only after the allowed DTO arrives.

name: 04 · Evening glance / calm display
audience: Shared tablet, with parent-controlled board settings
path: Today dinner and chores → idle calm display → configured night dim → tap wakes normal board without completing an action

Happy: Settle the day
Dinner, due work and use-soon summary remain in their normal priority order before idle display.
A wake tap returns to the board only.
Empty: No dinner planned
Use an honest empty dinner state; do not fabricate a recipe or default plan.
Plan a meal through a permitted personal flow.
Error: Display status is explicit
A settings-save failure keeps the previous valid settings; update failures show age/status.
Retry online or return to the shared board.
Offline: No fresh sync implied
Show retained content as stale/offline. Night/calm presentation does not imply successful synchronization.
Reconnect before new reads or gated changes.
Permission: Parent setup only
Parent elevation permits only the device setup allowlist. Device display never enables photos or coordinates.
End parent mode with Done or expiry.
Loading: Saving display settings
Keep the last valid settings visible while the requested change is pending. A wake tap must not activate an action.
Apply the new settings after successful save.

name: 05 · Quick-add event
audience: Parent or teen personal session; no device event-creation path
path: Calendar tab → Add event → date/time and required fields → save → calendar

Happy: One event, correct day
Use canonical event data; date/time belong to the intended day. Confirm successful save before leaving.
Return to calendar with the new event.
Empty: A blank calendar
The Add event action is visible for roles allowed to create; empty is distinct from failure.
Open the same form used from a filled calendar.
Error: Correct the event
Field and server failures remain visible; keep safe draft values and do not duplicate a saved event.
Correct or retry only the failed save.
Offline: Event creation needs connection
Event creation is outside the current offline mutation allowlist.
Keep a local form draft; save when online.
Permission: Creation is not editing
Teen create is allowed; parent-only edit/delete remain separate. A shared tablet has no event-create endpoint.
Use a permitted personal session.
Loading: Saving the event
Keep the safe draft and disable duplicate submission while the request is pending.
Wait for success or a visible failure.

name: 06 · Quick-add grocery
audience: All personal roles; paired-device add is a missing UI path
path: Lists → grocery list → Add item → canonical ListItem; shared board quick-add requires an explicit canonical list ID

Happy: Add to the right list
Use the household’s canonical List/ListItem. The existing device add route requires actor attribution and an idempotency key.
Show the saved item only after confirmed add.
Empty: Choose or create a grocery list
Current board DTO lacks a list ID when no unchecked item exists. Do not infer a list from the first row.
Resolve a canonical list before tablet quick-add.
Error: Keep the item text
Show validation/server failures. A retry uses the same operation identity where the route supports it.
Retry the add or correct the field.
Offline: Ticking is queued; adding is not
Explicit list-item checked state is queueable. Item creation is outside the current queue allowlist.
Keep add text unsaved; add when online.
Permission: Device writes may be off
Require both server switch and household device-write opt-in. Member selection attributes an action; it grants no role.
Show read-only state or parent setup guidance.
Loading: Adding the item
Retain text during the pending add; keep the operation identity stable for an idempotent retry.
Show saved state after the route confirms.

name: 07 · Quick-add meal
audience: Permitted personal session; shared-device dinner is read-only
path: Meals tab → select day / meal slot → add or choose a recipe → save canonical FamilyMeal → Tonight

Happy: Dinner has a plan
Use FamilyMeal and Recipe; do not write legacy MealPlan tables or create a tablet-specific model.
Return to the chosen day; Tonight reads that plan.
Empty: No meal planned
Offer a named meal or a permitted recipe choice without inventing ingredients or household preferences.
Add a meal in the personal Meals flow.
Error: Save did not finish
Show the real failure and retain safe form values. Recipe-to-grocery errors remain separate from meal save.
Retry the failed action; review duplicates.
Offline: Meal creation is online
Meal creation and recipe import are not queueable offline actions.
Keep safe draft text; save when online.
Permission: Dinner tile is not private access
A paired device cannot follow personal meal links. Household feature/role checks stay on the canonical APIs.
Use a permitted personal session.
Loading: Saving the meal
Keep the chosen day, slot and meal draft visible while pending; do not show success before the save.
Wait for the canonical meal response.

name: 08 · Quick-add task / chore
audience: Parent personal session; children complete assigned work
path: Today → All chores → Add chore → title / assignee / schedule → save → Today or chores

Happy: A clear household task
Use canonical Chore data, a checked household assignee and the intended schedule.
Return to chores; due work appears on Today.
Empty: No chores yet
A parent may add the first chore. Kid home states that there are no missions without showing an admin control.
Parent opens Add chore; child stays on home.
Error: Task not saved
Validation, assignment and server failures stay visible. A failed completion rolls back its optimistic state.
Correct or retry the failed operation.
Offline: Creation and completion are online
Chore creation/completion are not in the current offline queue allowlist; do not show pending local work as saved.
Reconnect before submitting; keep safe draft.
Permission: Done can await a parent check
Kid completion is not parent verification. Paired-device attribution grants no parent role or dashboard access.
Parent reviews in the personal chore flow.
Loading: Saving the chore
Keep the assignee and schedule draft visible while pending. Parent verification remains a separate operation.
Wait for success or a visible failure.

name: 09 · Parent mode and private boundaries
audience: Shared device setup versus parent phone administration
path: Shared board → parent identity proof → only device-allowlisted setup → Done / idle / hide / maximum expiry → shared board

Happy: Parent mode is scoped
PIN/password proof unlocks device setup only. Keep a visible parent banner and expiry; memory-only elevation token.
Done ends elevation and returns to the board.
Empty: No elevation is active
Default device mode remains shared. Choosing a member for a chore never unlocks administration.
Parent starts proof only for an allowed setup task.
Error: Proof failed or locked
Explain failure/lockout without exposing account secrets. Never keep a failed elevation active.
Retry after the permitted delay; return to board.
Offline: No offline elevation
Identity proof and setup changes need a live server. Hiding/reloading ends the in-memory elevation.
Return to shared mode; retry proof online.
Permission: Private stays on the phone
Even an elevated device has no finance/message/address/medical/account-data door. Android Back on /device/* backgrounds the task.
Open personal administration on the phone.
Loading: Checking parent identity
Show proof as pending; do not unlock setup controls or store an elevation token before success.
Enter the scoped parent mode only after confirmation.
